On the left, the woman with long twist braids (R2) wearing a black top and jeans sits on the lap of the shirtless man (R1) who is on the right. She cradles his head with her left hand, looking down at him with a warm smile. The shirtless man looks up at her, smiling widely. Warm orange light illuminates their skin from the side, contrasting with the cool teal background lighting.
